brief.zh: 用下面的元件，把这句话拼成公式。
brief.en: Build this sentence as a formula from the parts below.

say.zh: 要是什么都是鸟，那什么都会飞；所以鸟都会飞。
say.en: If everything is a bird, then everything flies; so every bird flies.

hint.zh: 前提是一句「如果……那么……」，两边各是一句 ∀；整段推理又是一句「如果……那么……」。
hint.en: The premise is an “if … then …” with a ∀ sentence on each side; the whole reasoning is another “if … then …”.

say.zh: 要是什么都是鸟，那什么都会飞；所以鸟都会飞。
say.en: If everything is a bird, then everything flies; so every bird flies.

brief.zh: 这段推理写成了引理。造一个反例：前提都成立，结论不成立。
brief.en: The reasoning is written as a lemma. Build a counterexample: every premise holds and the goal fails.

hint.zh: 前提的条件「什么都是鸟」，只要有一样东西不是鸟，就不成立。
hint.en: The premise’s condition, “everything is a bird”, fails as soon as one thing is not a bird.
